title: The S23 Ultra leak record
summary: A retrospective record of major S23 Ultra reports from August 2022 through launch, paired with Samsung’s announcement so old predictions keep their eventual outcomes.

claims.title: The 200-megapixel main camera arrived
claims.summary: Notebookcheck and GSMArena relayed Ice Universe’s 200-megapixel sensor reports, while Android Central separately relayed Yogesh Brar’s 200-megapixel main-camera specification. Samsung’s launch material subsequently specified a 200-megapixel Adaptive Pixel main camera.
claims.assessment: The central resolution claim was confirmed at launch. Early sensor-name details remained less consistent than the 200-megapixel headline.

claims.title: CAD renders showed an S22 Ultra-like silhouette
claims.summary: CAD-based renders published by OnLeaks and Smartprix showed a design close to the S22 Ultra, retaining the separate camera rings, flat top and bottom edges, and a slightly flatter side profile.
claims.assessment: The renders proved broadly representative, but the archived evidence remains a pre-release CAD report rather than an official design file.

claims.title: A flatter display surface was correctly anticipated
claims.summary: Notebookcheck relayed Ice Universe’s claim of less pronounced curvature. Samsung later described the 6.8-inch edge display as having reduced curvature and a larger, flatter usable surface.
claims.assessment: The directional design claim was confirmed by Samsung, without treating an early render as an exact production blueprint.

claims.title: The 5,000 mAh battery report held
claims.summary: SamMobile reported that Samsung would retain a 5,000 mAh typical battery capacity. Samsung’s launch specification later listed 5,000 mAh typical and 4,855 mAh rated capacity.
claims.assessment: The reported typical capacity was confirmed. Typical and rated capacities remain distinct measurements.

claims.title: The custom Snapdragon branding was real
claims.summary: Leaked marketing material shown by Roland Quandt carried the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 for Galaxy name. Samsung’s launch announcement confirmed that optimized platform across the Galaxy S23 series.
claims.assessment: Both the custom branding and the chipset generation were confirmed by official launch material.

claims.title: 45-watt wired charging stayed unchanged
claims.summary: Pre-launch reporting listed 45-watt wired charging for the S23 Ultra. Samsung’s final specification also listed a 45-watt adapter and 5-amp USB-C cable for wired charging.
claims.assessment: The charging ceiling was confirmed; the adapter was sold separately and real charging behavior depends on the supported cable and charger.

claims.title: The Ultra moved to a 12-megapixel selfie camera
claims.summary: A leaked comparison sheet reported by Android Authority showed a 12-megapixel front camera instead of the previous Ultra’s 40-megapixel count. Samsung’s launch specifications confirmed the 12-megapixel selfie camera.
claims.assessment: The resolution was confirmed. Calling it a downgrade based only on pixel count was an interpretation, not a measured image-quality result.

claims.title: Leaked color labels did not match the launch names
claims.summary: XDA relayed render labels of Cotton Flower, Botanic Green and Misty Lilac alongside Phantom Black. Samsung launched the corresponding main range as Cream, Green, Lavender and Phantom Black.
claims.assessment: The visual palette was directionally close, but the reported retail names were not the final announced names.
